fields.label: Support Needed from Manager
fields.description: Employee describes what support they need from their manager.

fields.label: Overall Rating (Manager)
fields.description: Manager's overall rating. Not visible to employee until they submit their final review.

fields.label: Potential Rating (Manager)
fields.description: Manager's potential rating for the employee (1-5).

fields.label: Manager Feedback to Employee
fields.description: Visible to employee only after manager submits final review.

fields.label: Manager Internal Notes
fields.description: Private manager notes — never visible to the employee.

fields.label: Show Reviewer Comments to Employee
fields.description: If checked, invited reviewer comments are shown to the employee in their final review.

fields.label: Invited Reviewers (JSON)
fields.description: JSON array: [{employee, employee_name, user, status, comments, submitted_on}]

fields.label: Overall Comment to Manager
fields.description: Employee's overall message to the manager, written at the end of their self-review.

fields.label: Review Page Data (JSON)
fields.description: Stores employee's self-assessment inputs per page as a JSON blob.

fields.label: Pages Completed (JSON)
fields.description: JSON array of page keys the employee has saved.

fields.label: Archived
fields.description: HR-only flag. Archived reviews are hidden from the default list view.
